title: Automation Tester / SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Automation Tester / SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)**

**Corporate Title: Analyst**

**Location: Pune, India**

  

**Role Description**

* The Automation Tester / SDET is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated test solutions across APIs, user interfaces, databases, microservices, and end-to-end business flows. The role works closely with engineering and delivery teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipeline.
The successful candidate combines strong testing fundamentals with hands-on coding, database validation, and automation expertise. The role will help improve release confidence, test coverage, defect detection, and the reliability of distributed applications.  

  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

  

**Your Key Responsibilities:**

* **Automation Framework Development -** Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks using Java or Python.
* **API and Microservices Testing -** Validate REST APIs and distributed microservices, including request and response contracts, error handling, integrations, and service-to-service flows.
* **UI Test Automation -** Build and maintain reliable browser-based test automation using Playwright, or Selenium where appropriate.
* **Database Validation -** Create and execute SQL queries to verify data integrity, transformations, persistence, and end-to-end processing across supported databases.
* **End-to-End Quality Assurance -** Plan and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing across complex application workflows.
* **CI/CD Integration -** Integrate automated tests into GitHub Actions and delivery pipelines, analyse failures, and support quality gates.
* **Performance Testing -** Develop and execute performance tests using Gatling and, where relevant, JMeter or k6.
* **Defect Analysis and Collaboration -** Investigate defects, provide reproducible evidence, and work with developers and product stakeholders to drive resolution.
* **Test Reporting and Continuous Improvement -** Maintain clear test results, coverage visibility, and reusable test assets while continuously improving automation effectiveness.

  

**Your skills and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university with a concentration in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent discipline.
* More than 2 years of relevant experience in software testing, test automation, quality engineering, or an SDET role.
* Hands-on experience creating maintainable automated tests, debugging failures, and working with development teams in an agile delivery model.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.  

  

**Must-Have Skills & Tools**

* + API Testing (Postman, Bruno)
  + Test Automation (Playwright preferred, Selenium)
  + SQL / Database Validation (Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  + End-to-End & Microservices Testing (Postman, Playwright, REST Assured, PyTest)
  + CI/CD Testing (Git, GitHub Actions)
  + Java/Python Programming (REST Assured, PyTest)
  + Performance Testing (Gatling)
  undefined

  
  

**Good-to-Have Skills & Tools**

Search Platform Testing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Solr)AI/RAG Application Testing (Python, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch)Cloud Testing (GCP, AWS)Log Analysis & Monitoring (Grafana, Kibana)Container & Platform Testing (Docker, Kubernetes)Advanced Performance Testing (JMeter, k6)  

  

**How we’ll support you**

* Training and development to help you excel in your career
* Coaching and support from experts in your team
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs  

  

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

  

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk
description:
HackerOne is a global leader in Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The HackerOne Platform unites agentic AI solutions with the ingenuity of the world’s largest community of security researchers to continuously discover, validate, prioritize, and remediate exposures across code, cloud, and AI systems. Through solutions like bug bounty, vulnerability disclosure, agentic pentesting, AI red teaming, and code security, HackerOne delivers measurable, continuous reduction of cyber risk for enterprises. Industry leaders, including Anthropic, Crypto.com, General Motors, Goldman Sachs, Lufthansa, Uber, UK Ministry of Defence, and the U.S. Department of Defense, trust HackerOne to safeguard their digital ecosystems. HackerOne was recognized in Gartner’s Emerging Tech Impact Radar: AI Cybersecurity Ecosystem report for its leadership in AI Security Testing and has been named a Most Loved Workplace for Young Professionals (2024).

HackerOne is at a pivotal inflection point in the security industry. Offensive security is no longer optional – it is the standard for forward-thinking companies that want to build trust and resilience in a world where AI-driven innovation and adversaries are moving faster than ever. With the industry shifting, HackerOne stands apart: we combine the ingenuity of the largest security research community with a best-in-class AI-powered platform, trusted by the world’s top organizations.

**HackerOne Values**

HackerOne is dedicated to fostering a strong and inclusive culture. HackerOne is **Customer Obsessed** and prioritizes customer outcomes in our decisions and actions. We **Default to Disclosure** by operating with transparency and integrity, ensuring trust and accountability. Employees, researchers, customers, and partners **Win Together** by fostering empowerment, inclusion, respect, and accountability.

**Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk**
============================================

### **Location: Pune, India (working onsite)**

**Position Summary**
--------------------

HackerOne is building an AI-native approach to Enterprise IT, where AI agents are the first line of support and every human interaction becomes an opportunity to make those agents smarter. As Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk, you will build and operate this model—combining exceptional internal customer service with hands-on engineering to create AI agents, automations, and support experiences that help Hackeronies do their best work.

This is not a traditional help desk role. You will work in a highly technical, developer-heavy environment and be expected to build with AI yourself: writing code, developing and improving agents, understanding developer workflows, and using data to systematically shift support from human intervention toward automated resolution. The underlying model is Tier 1 AI Agents, Tier 2 human support/on-call, and Tier 3+ deep technical escalation to owning teams, with the explicit goal of continually moving repeatable work toward Tier 1.

We opened our new office in Pune, India to welcome team members who value in-person connection, collaboration, and shared purpose. For the types of challenges we’ll tackle and the work we’ll do together, we believe in-person connection will be essential to building strong relationships, solving problems effectively, and fostering a vibrant community.

As a fully integrated part of HackerOne’s global team, the Pune office will play a meaningful role in advancing our culture and mission. At HackerOne, we Win Together – and our Pune team will help lead the way by shaping a dynamic, in-person culture rooted in purpose and partnership.

**Primary Responsibilities**
----------------------------

Success in the Senior Automation Engineer, IT Help Desk role will be accomplished by delivering on the responsibilities below in alignment with the Values and Principles that define how we work at HackerOne.

* Build an **AI Native** IT support experience in which AI agents serve as Tier 1, providing automated first-pass and self-service resolution before requests reach human support. Write code and build, deploy, operate, and continuously improve the agents and automations that power this experience.
* Own the effectiveness of the Tier 1 / Tier 2 / Tier 3+ support model: enable Tier 2 to resolve issues AI cannot, establish clear paths to deep technical owners at Tier 3+, and systematically turn recurring human resolutions into knowledge, tooling, and automation that can move back into Tier 1.
* Deliver an exceptional internal customer experience across a highly technical organization, supporting developer workflows and tooling while creating a clear, consistent, trusted path for Hackeronies to get help.
* Apply **Data-Driven Decision Making** to deeply understand support demand and performance. Instrument the support experience, identify patterns and failure modes, and use measures such as Tier 1 resolution and owning-team velocity to determine where engineering and automation can have the greatest impact.
* Use **First Principles Problem Solving** to attack the root cause of recurring support needs rather than repeatedly treating symptoms. Simplify systems, eliminate unnecessary work, and design durable solutions that reduce friction for employees and technical teams.
* Practice **Change Agility** as AI capabilities, enterprise tooling, and HackerOne’s ways of working rapidly evolve. Experiment, learn from failures, and continuously adapt the support architecture as better models, tools, and approaches become available.
* Provide technically credible support across a broad enterprise environment spanning identity and access, collaboration, endpoints, SaaS, developer tooling, APIs, data systems, and AI infrastructure, while partnering effectively with Security, Engineering, Enterprise Systems, and other owning teams for deep technical escalations.
* Establish an obsessive feedback loop between service and engineering: understand what Hackeronies are trying to accomplish, document what AI cannot yet solve, identify opportunities to improve agents and tooling, and make the support experience measurably better over time.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* Significant hands-on experience supporting a technical, developer-heavy organization, with demonstrated understanding of developer workflows and tools such as Git, development environments, APIs, and AI-enabled developer tooling.
* Hands-on software development and automation experience, including demonstrated experience using AI to build working solutions—not simply consuming AI applications—with the ability to write, test, debug, deploy, and maintain code used in production workflows.
* Experience building or operating AI agents, LLM-powered applications, agentic workflows, or comparable AI automation, including integrating AI capabilities with enterprise systems, APIs, data, or internal tooling.
* Experience operating technically complex enterprise support or IT environments across areas such as identity and access, SaaS applications, collaboration platforms, endpoints, and developer tooling, with demonstrated ability to diagnose problems and determine when deep technical escalation is required.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with technologies represented in HackerOne’s support environment, such as Okta, 1Password, Slack APIs, Kandji, AWS, Bedrock, Linear, Claude, ChatGPT, Workato, Google Workspace, or comparable platforms.
* Experience designing or improving tiered support, self-service, or automated service models where automation measurably reduced human support volume.
* Experience instrumenting support systems and using operational data to improve resolution rates, service quality, automation coverage, or engineering productivity.
* Experience working in a fast-moving SaaS, cybersecurity, developer-tools, or similarly technical environment.

**Job Benefits:**
-----------------

* Health (medical, vision, dental), life, and disability insurance\*
* Equity stock options
* Retirement plans
* Paid public holidays and unlimited PTO
* Paid maternity and parental leave
* Leaves of absence (including caregiver leave and leave under CO's Healthy Families and Workplaces Act)
* Employee Assistance Program
* **Eligibility may differ by country**

We're committed to building a global team! For certain roles outside the United States, India, the U.K., and the Netherlands, we partner with Remote.com as our Employer of Record (EOR).

Visa/work permit sponsorship is not available.

*Employment at HackerOne is contingent on a background check.*

HackerOne is an Equal Opportunity Employer in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, pregnancy, disability or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, federal, state, or local laws.

This policy applies to all HackerOne employment practices, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. HackerOne makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

For US based roles only: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, all qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for the position.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**QA Test Automation Engineer**

**Location:** Pune HO, India (In Campus) • **Experience:** 3–5 years • **Team:** Validation

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a QA engineer who thinks in frameworks, not test cases. You’ll own and grow the automated testing that gives us confidence to ship changes across a distributed, hardware-in-the-loop system — from API and integration layers up through operator-facing UIs — and wire that testing into CI so regressions get caught before they reach a warehouse floor.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Design, build, and maintain automated test suites (API, integration, UI, and end-to-end) for our control and fulfilment systems.
* Own test automation frameworks — choosing the right tools, keeping them fast and non-flaky, and making them easy for engineers to extend.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) so quality gates run on every merge, with clear signal on failures.
* Build test coverage for services that talk over message queues (RabbitMQ) and persist to PostgreSQL, including data-integrity and state-transition checks.
* Design and run performance, load, and reliability tests against critical paths, and help define pass/fail thresholds.
* Partner with developers to shift testing left — reviewing testability of new features, defining acceptance criteria, and contributing to test strategy early in the cycle.
* Triage, reproduce, and root-cause defects; write clear, reproducible reports and track them to closure.
* Contribute to release readiness — go/no-go assessments, regression sign-off, and release validation across projects.

**What you’ll need**
--------------------

* 3–5 years in software QA / test automation, with a strong track record building automated suites (not just running manual cases).
* Solid programming ability in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript for writing maintainable test code.
* Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks — e.g. Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium for UI, and pytest / REST-assured / Postman-Newman for API testing.
* Practical experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines and reasoning about flaky-test mitigation, parallelisation, and test data management.
* Comfort with API testing (REST), reading logs, and querying databases (SQL) to validate behaviour end-to-end.
* Strong debugging instincts and the ability to isolate whether a failure is in the test, the code, the data, or the environment.
* Clear written communication for defect reports, test plans, and release notes.

**Good to have**
----------------

* Experience testing distributed systems, event-driven architectures, or message-queue-based services (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
* Exposure to performance/load testing tools (k6, Locust, JMeter).
* Familiarity with containerised environments (Docker/Podman) and setting up reproducible test environments.
* Experience with hardware-in-the-loop, IoT, robotics, or other systems where software meets the physical world.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana) to validate system behaviour under test.
* Prior work in warehousing, logistics, or industrial automation domains.

description:
**Location: Pune (Hybrid)**  
**Permanent - Full Time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

Your role is to turn raw support data into action.
  
  
You will identify opportunities for automation and improvement, translate insights into prioritized recommendations, and help implement changes directly across the support ecosystem.
  
  
You will focus on delivering measurable outcomes such as reduced ticket volume, improved customer satisfaction and improved and consistent adherence to SLA whilst significantly contributing to operating efficiency and cost to serve.
  
  
This is not a traditional analytics role — you are expected to actively shape outcomes by combining analysis with hands-on execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

Work closely with the AI CX Lead to prioritise, shape and execute against the AI customer experience roadmap.
  
  
**Data Extraction & Engineering:**  

* Extract and maintain datasets from Zendesk and related systems
* Build and optimise data pipelines into reporting and collaboration tools
* Ensure data quality, structure and accessibility

  
**Analysis & Insight Generation:**  

* Analyse ticket drivers, trends and behaviours across products
* Identify automation and deflection opportunities
* Segment data to uncover high-impact insights
* Synthesise customer interactions into clear Voice of Customer themes and experience insights

  
**Translating Insight into Action:**  

* Translate analysis into clear, prioritised recommendations
* Build a pipeline of improvement opportunities
* Quantify impact (volume, effort, return)
* Communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive prioritisation

  
**Implementation & Experimentation:**  

* Implement improvements via Zendesk configuration, automation workflows and APIs
* Support rollout of AI and automation initiatives
* Design and run structured experiments to validate improvements and measure impact

  
**Reporting & Continuous Improvement:**  

* Build dashboards and reporting on performance and opportunities
* Feed insights into the AI CX roadmap
* Drive ongoing optimisation cycles

**Experience and Skills**

* 3–7 years in data analytics, analytics engineering or CX analytics
* Experience with support platforms (Zendesk or similar) desirable
* Strong SQL and data modelling skills
* Experience building dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* Familiarity with APIs and automation workflows
* Ability to analyse customer journeys to identify friction points and improvements
* Strong data storytelling and ability to present insights in a clear, compelling way

**Working for Us**  
At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - Come join us.
